name: DRB Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: DRB Holding Co., Ltd., established in 1945 and headquartered in Busan, South Korea, operates globally as a comprehensive manufacturer and supplier. The company's diverse product portfolio primarily encompasses automotive sealing mechanisms, various construction materials, and advanced solutions for seismic isolation and vibration dampening. Its offerings for the automotive industry include essential sealing components such as glass run/channels, along with seals for doors, vehicle bodies, tailgates, and hoods. For rail infrastructure, DRB provides specialized products like low vibration track systems, ballast mats, platform gap fillers, and rail fastening systems. The marine sector benefits from products like durable rubber fenders, automatic cable cover belts, and other nautical accessories. DRB also develops eco-friendly solutions, featuring rubber dams, eco-tanks, versatile HDPE catch basins, and intercepted flow control devices. In civil engineering and industrial applications, the company supplies submerged gaskets, tank membranes, shock mounts, diaphragms, waterproof sheets, sluice seals, gas holders, crash cushions, and industrial door seals. A core strength lies in its sophisticated structural protection systems, which include natural, lead, and high damping rubber bearings for isolation. Additionally, it offers various damper systems such such as easy/MEED, lintel-type vibration control, SSF, and door/window-type dampers. These are complemented by structural systems like composite beam technologies and specialized engineering services. Furthermore, DRB Holding Co., Ltd. is a significant producer of power transmission belts for industrial, automotive, agricultural, and niche applications, alongside a range of conveyor belts and systems, as well as rubber tracks and pads. The company also facilitates sales of its products through online platforms.
